title: Penthouse October 1993 Richard Lewis Andrew Dice Clay Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, October 1993, original $4.95 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Pet: Levena Holmes. "Fear of Commitment Wedding Chapel" cover with comedian Richard Lewis.

Cover features: Richard Lewis - will he ever find the perfect woman?; 20 Worst - college football's rotten roster; Andrew Dice Clay - would you believe he's fashionable?; Erica Jong; Hail Cesar! Boxing's implacable, ruthless terminator.

Back cover: Viceroy cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
